protocol.name: nidara_window_controls_v1

description.summary: window controls drawn by the compositor over an app's header

protocol.description: A window's controls — close, minimize, maximize — are the compositor's: it draws them, the same in every window, and takes their clicks. The app keeps its own header and its content, and says where in it the controls go: it reserves a box of the size the compositor gives, at the place its layout wants (in the header, or inside a sidebar), and the compositor draws the controls there, over the app's own pixels. The place can move with the layout; the side (left or right) and the buttons are the user's, and the compositor tells them as the box's size.

request.name: get_window_controls

description.summary: the controls of a toplevel's surface

request.description: One per wl_surface, which must have the xdg_toplevel role (or get it before its first commit with a position). The state is double-buffered on wl_surface.commit, so the controls move with the buffer that leaves room for them.

event.name: layout

description.summary: the box to reserve, and the side it belongs on

event.description: Sent once right after get_window_controls, and again whenever the box changes: the user changes the side or the buttons, the window's buttons change (set_buttons, or what it can do — a window that cannot change size has no maximize). width and height are the box the controls take, logical pixels; the client lays out a box of that size on that side and sends its position. On the left side the close button comes first; on the right, last.

description.summary: the compositor draws no controls on this surface any more

request.name: set_position
request.description: The top-left corner of the reserved box, surface-local logical coordinates. Until the first set_position, and after unset_position, no controls are drawn.

request.name: set_buttons

description.summary: pending: the buttons this window has

request.description: Which buttons this window wants, double-buffered on wl_surface.commit (an About window: close alone). Close is always kept. Until it is sent, every button. The compositor shows those that are asked for AND that the user chose AND that the window can do, and the box in layout follows.
